data.gender_notes: Annadiane is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Annadiane is a combination of Anna, meaning grace, and Diane, meaning divine. In Greek mythology, Annadiane could be associated with the goddess Aphrodite, who symbolizes love, beauty, and fertility. In Christian tradition, the name Annadiane represents the grace and divinity of the Christian faith. The name Annadiane carries the meaning “Graceful and divine woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Annadiane usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and divine woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
